pages.text: Tobacconist has client, common, and server configuration. Most players never need to edit them, but server owners can simplify quality gameplay or disable the custom Nicotine effect.

$(thing)Server — enableQualitySystem$()$(br)Default: true. Hides/ignores quality scoring and quality-based smoking bonuses when false while preserving existing quality data.$(br2)$(thing)Server — enableNicotineEffects$()$(br)Default: true. Controls only Tobacconist's Nicotine status effect.
pages.title: Gameplay Toggles

pages.text: $(thing)Common — additionalEffects$()$(br)Adds configurable effects when smoking. Each entry uses: $(item)effect_id,duration_ticks,amplifier$(). Example: minecraft:luck,200,0.$(br2)These effects are independent from the Nicotine toggle.
pages.title: Additional Effects

pages.text: $(thing)Client — particleDensity$()$(br)Default: 6, range 1–24. This is the chance divisor for ambient Curios Mouth-slot smoke; lower values mean more frequent smoke particles.
pages.title: Client Particles

pages.text: Server configs are world/server-side settings; common and client configs live with the normal Forge configuration files. Exact filenames are generated from the mod ID and config type by Forge.
pages.title: Where Settings Live
